thread:
oncall-bot: ALERT: kv-cache eviction rate x20, continuous-batching queue depth spike on mistral-pool-a. Latency p99 > 1200ms, error% increased. Paging oncall.
sam: seeing the same in grafana. prefetched prefixes jumping, KV hitrate dropping. Customers hitting 502 on chat endpoints.
maria: paging now. I'm oncall. tagging eng-runtime and sre.
eng-runtime-bot: Incident created -> INC-2026-1482. Runbook: /runbooks/kv-contbatch
jordan: quick check — is this correlated with the 03:00 deploy? I see a config push to batch_window_ms=18 yesterday.
sam: deploy was 02:58 to mistral pool only. config change in canary then rolled. cpu on GPU nodes doesn't look saturated.
sre-jen: eviction graphs look like a cascade: prefetch + continuous batching holding large KV entries leading to eviction churn. likely memory pressure causing cache blowup.
casey-cs: CS report: two enterprise customers reported increased latency and some 5xxs starting ~03:10, they want ETA and mitigation.
maria: short mitigation plan: 1) reduce batch_window_ms back to 8 on mistral pool, 2) toggle off continuous batching for mistral models temporarily, 3) enable model fallback to qwen-lite for requests over threshold. doing step 1-2 now.
sam: ack. prepping hotfix. I'll push a config patch to runtime control plane.
eng-runtime-bot: Lock check passed. Author: sam. Applying patch -> /configs/runtime/mistral/pool-a.yaml
sam: applying patch:
```
PATCH /runtime/v1/pools/mistral/pool-a
- batch_window_ms: 18
+ batch_window_ms: 8
- continuous_batching: true
+ continuous_batching: false
```
ops-liz: I'm scaling pool-a by +2 nodes to give breathing room while we toggle.
maria: doing traffic policy change: route >= 2s requests to fallback qwen-lite. small risk of quality regression but reduces tail.
sre-jen: monitoring eviction rate and p99, set alert to auto-escalate if p99>1500ms for 10m.
eng-runtime-bot: Patch applied. Response: 200 OK. Rollout status: 24/24 shards updated.
sam: verifying metrics... eviction rate dropping, hitrate slowly recovering.
casey-cs: notified customers with interim note: "We are mitigating a latency regression; expected improvement in 10-20 minutes. We'll follow up."
jordan: logs show a specific workload pattern causing extremely wide prefix cardinality (search-autocomplete burst). That plus continuous batching kept large KV entries in memory.
maria: I want a short-term config change on prefetch: set prefetch_max_prefixes=500 -> 200. Doing that now.
sam: applied prefetch cap. Also bumped cache-ttl down for large keys: 300s -> 120s for entries > 1MB.
eng-runtime-bot: Config changes applied. Observability: p95 improved to ~210ms, p99 trending down.
sre-jen: looks stable for 5m. Evictions decreased by 78% since hotfix.
casey-cs: customers replied grateful, some still seeing tiny errors but much improved.
maria: next: create follow-up ticket for root cause analysis and config hardening. Include run of reproduction with high prefix cardinality and continuous batching enabled.
jordan: adding model-specific note: Mistral MQA behavior appears more stateful for KV usage; toggling continuous batching on Qwen didn't show same blowup in staging.
sam: for postmortem, collect: config diffs, deploy history, heap dumps, cache metrics, request traces for affected customers.
ops-liz: scaling will be reverted after 2 hours if stable. I'll annotate rollback window.
eng-runtime-bot: INC-2026-1482 updated: mitigation done, monitoring. Next oncall: maria -> sam handoff at 3055556900.
maria: handoff: short summary -> spike caused by combined effects: batch_window increase + continuous_batching on mistral + high prefix cardinality workload. Actions taken: rolled batch_window and disabled continuous batching, limited prefetch prefixes, lowered TTL for large keys, scaled pool. Customers notified. Next actions: RCA ticket, perf test and guardrails for config changes, add canary throttles.
sam: thanks — taking watch. logging link: https://grafana.redwood/INC-2026-1482
casey-cs: I'll keep customers updated and open a support ticket tracker.
sre-jen: will start RCA doc and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml for model-specific profiling.
maria: closing loop here. If anything regresses ping immediately. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1482: Mitigation complete. Status: monitoring -> stable.
